title: cruminium virginianum
intro: Cruminium virginianum, commonly known as Virginian cranesbill or American cranesbill, is a flowering plant belonging to the Geraniaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and aid in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Cruminium virginianum include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, making it a potential treatment for pain relief and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
